_doc: Hand corrections applied by the VIEWER to the built tiles (pipeline/overrides.json is the pipeline's own; fold these into the pipeline on the next full rebuild: docs/TODO.md). Local metres (x east, z south). Every entry needs a 'why' and a 'source'. roadSurface: road id -> OSM-style surface (viewer/roadData.js SURFACE). plazas: paved open areas drawn as their own draped mesh (viewer/plazas.js) instead of the grass default; 'courseDeg' = direction of the stone rows (degrees from +x toward +z).

roadSurface._why: Was: the six roads named Place de Saint-Job forced to setts (2026-11-04). Corrected 2026-11-05: the owner checked on site that the ROADS round the Place, tram included, are asphalt with the grooved rails flush in it, as OSM says; the setts are on the SQUARE itself, which stands at sidewalk height with kerbs all round (UrbIS Land cover type P, drawn raised by viewer/surfaces.js with ?roads=surface; the plazas entry below for the default view).

plazas.why: Place de Saint-Job between the setts Chaussée (north) and Avenue du Prince de Ligne: one setts square with rows of plane trees and parking; OSM has no area for it, so it fell back to grass.
plazas.source: outline from the tile's roads.json (road centrelines); surface from the owner's photos 2026-11-04

plazas.why: Place de Saint-Job between Avenue du Prince de Ligne and the Place streets in front of the church (kiosk, terraces): setts.
plazas.source: outline from roads.json; surface from the owner's photos 2026-11-04

flyStart.why: Fly mode starts just above the tip of the Saint-Job church spire (its highest vertex in G4 buildings.bin: 1201.64, 130.25, 549.25), heading over Place de Saint-Job (owner, 2026-11-04).

centreLine._why: Rue Edith Cavell (OSM tertiary -> engine type 'collector') got the type's default dashed centre line; the measured-paint rule removes guessed centre lines on residential types only. The 2024 orthophoto shows no centre line along it (checked at (569, -1300), (540, -1040), (600, -760), (632, -640): parking bays on both sides, a SCHOOL legend, no line), and UrbIS Topo has none. Keys: OSM way ids (every piece rWAY_n of the way).
centreLine._source: UrbIS orthophoto 2024 (CC0), looked at in roads round 5 (2026-11-13)
